metadata.title: Research Platform – Data SSPP Overlay
metadata.remarks: Secure Data overlay governing research datasets, including regulated, sensitive, and externally shared data.

props.name: external-sharing
props.remarks: External sharing permitted only under classification, DLP, encryption, and contractual constraints.

props.name: identity-relation
props.remarks: Linkage between data and identity must respect consent, anonymization, and ethics approvals.

props.name: retention-boundary
props.remarks: Retention aligns with research ethics, funding agreements, and regulatory obligations.

control-implementation.remarks: Research systems inherit Secure Data enforcement and may not bypass classification, encryption, DLP, or retention controls.
